notes.title: 🛠️ Chamber X - Full Release Update (June 2025)
notes.content: [list][*][p]Updated UI and in-game menu for improved clarity and polish,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collision in several hidden rooms for smoother player navigation,[/p][/*][*][p]Refined the look of various in-game items to enhance atmosphere,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased interaction distance for picking up and reading notes,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy count to 1 for tighter pacing, with updated monster texture and design,[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioned some interactable items to improve exploration and flow,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of the first key to help players progress more smoothly[/p][/*][/list]
